slides.title: The laundry loop: one load, washer to drawer, same day
Why laundry never ends
slides.body: We start loads and forget them. Each stop (wash, dry, fold, put away) is a place we drop off.

slides.title: Start it only when you're home for 2 hours
slides.body: Morning weekend, or right after work. Never before bed or before leaving. Timing is half the system.

slides.title: Set 2 alarms right away
slides.body: One for the washer, one for the dryer. Name them 'MOVE LAUNDRY'. Do it the second you press start.

slides.title: Put away before the next load
slides.body: No new load until the last one is away. One load moving at a time. No mountain.

slides.title: Fold at the drawer, not the couch
slides.body: Carry the basket to the bedroom and fold straight in. Folded laundry on the couch becomes a new doom pile.

slides.title: I don't have a laundry problem. I have a laundry-in-the-washer-for-3-days problem.
The full laundry loop
slides.body: The laundry loop and 6 other systems are in The Messy Brain Home Reset. Link in bio.
